normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists inside _transfer and is used for its blacklist and sender logic.
The to parameter is only consumed by the limit checks inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is only used for the limit comparisons inside _transfer.
The tokens parameter is only used in the arithmetic of swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount is only approved and passed to the router swap.
ethAmount becomes the ETH value forwarded by the external addLiquidityETH call.
tokenAmount is only approved and supplied to the router liquidity call.
tAmount is only used to compute reflections and adjust _rTotal inside deliver.
maxTxPercent is only used in the arithmetic that recomputes _maxTxAmount.
time is only added to block.timestamp to produce _lockTime.
newOwner is only used to reassign the _owner state variable.
account is only inserted into the blacklist structures.
buy_tax is only written into the buyFee struct by the owner-gated bulk setter.
The local balance cache is only compared with _maxTxAmount and the swap threshold inside _transfer.
takeFee is produced in _transfer and consumed to select the fee mode in _tokenTransfer.
This flag only gates the external swapAndLiquify invocation.
The cached rate is only used to scale the liquidity credit inside _takeLiquidity.
tFee is returned from _getTValues and consumed by _reflectFee.
The denominator is only used for the fee split arithmetic inside swapAndLiquify.
unitBalance only feeds the marketing and dev payout computations in swapAndLiquify.
initialBalance only provides the ETH delta baseline inside swapAndLiquify.
The path array is only constructed and passed to the router swap.
rAmount is returned from _getRValues and applied to the sender balance by the transfer helpers.
